cohort: The study included 45 gestational diabetes patients (15 diet-controlled, 30 insulin-requiring) and 45 healthy pregnant women.
finding: The second-trimester monocyte to high-density lipoprotein ratio was significantly higher in gestational diabetes patients and in those requiring insulin, indicating its potential as a marker for detecting gestational diabetes and predicting insulin requirement.
mod_finding: The monocyte to high-density lipoprotein ratio did not predict cesarean section in gestational diabetes.
